prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished, exceptionally high-quality Chinese website visual concept, not a photograph of a monitor. Product: 报名表检查器, a local offline CSV signup list checker for event organizers. Art direction inspired by the precision and typography of Apple's MacBook Pro product storytelling, but absolutely no Apple logos, hardware, copied layouts or product branding. Quiet sophistication, enormous deliberate negative space, superb Chinese sans typography, white #ffffff and #f5f5f7 with near-black #1d1d1f, restrained vivid blue #0071e3. One planned dark narrative chapter uses #08090b. All text perfectly legible simplified Chinese. No English decorative labels, no eyebrows above headlines, no sidebar, no admin dashboard, no generic card grid, no excessive pills, no gratuitous metrics, no excessive glowing orbs. Precise alignment, intentional asymmetric/centered section rhythms, hairline dividers, optically balanced solid-blue capsule CTAs 48px high. Nav minimal text wordmark 报名表检查器 on left and 上传报名表 blue CTA on right, no icon/logo. Generate only specified screen, no presentation slide annotations or devices. This is concept only; actual future UI text and controls will be native HTML, assets separable, no raster screenshot as production UI. White must stay white, not cream. Do not invent features, online accounts, AI, speed claims, charts or social proof. SCREEN 1 of coordinated set: desktop HOME opening hero, 1440x1000 approximate landscape. Nav at top with slim bottom rule. Huge beautifully typeset centered headline exactly "把报名表，\n理清楚。" at 88px perceived, two lines, upper center with generous breathing room. Supporting one line "重复报名、缺失信息、邮箱格式，一次检查清楚。" at22px medium gray. Clearly visible centered blue primary button "上传报名表" and simple text link "看看如何检查" below headline. Lower half contains ONE striking large product visualization: three thin translucent silver-white CSV sheets aligned in a refined floating perspective stack, cropped softly near lower edge, delicate real shadows, front sheet with restrained rows and columns, one narrow blue selection line, modest small CSV text on corner; no macOS window controls, no full dashboard, no bubbly icons. Stack symbolizes messy data becoming aligned. Clean editorial composition, product-focused visual like a premium Apple software product reveal. Small quiet bottom line "本地处理，不上传你的报名数据。" No statistics here.
